# Best 2kWh portable power station for an RV under $900 (2026)

Prices checked on the makers' US stores on 2026-10-31.

**Short answer.** Under $900, the best 2 kWh portable power station for an RV is the **BLUETTI AC200L**: 2,048 Wh LiFePO4, 2,400 W output, a TT-30 (30-amp RV) outlet, 1,200 W solar input and a 5-year warranty. $899, or $854.05 with code AFF5OFF (tested daily in BLUETTI's cart, last passed 2026-10-30). Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac200l . It is late in its life but was in stock on bluettipower.com on 2026-10-31. Also consider the Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 ($899.99, lightest at 41.7 lb) and the Renogy PowerStation 2000 ($849).

## What to look for

- **Continuous output, not just capacity.** 2,200–2,600 W runs a fridge, microwave or coffee maker, one big load at a time.
- **LiFePO4 battery** for 3,000–6,000 cycles.
- **An RV outlet (TT-30)** so the shore cord plugs in without an adapter.
- **Recharging:** fast AC charging (about 1–1.5 hours), solar input, and car charging.
- **Weight:** 40–62 lb in this class.
- **Warranty:** 5 years is standard here.

## 2 kWh stations for an RV under $900

Elite 200 V2: https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2 . Jackery's Explorer 2000 v2 is a popular pick but is $999 on Jackery's store and has no RV outlet.

## How long it lasts

A 2 kWh station runs a typical RV fridge for about a day and a half. Add 200–400 W of solar to stretch a weekend.
